name: Staggered Aura
rationale: Two rings whose openings never line up, so nothing passes straight through; the core sits inside.
check_16px: Three elements in 16 px: the gaps close up and it reads as a target or spiral blob.

name: Glass C
rationale: A C of stacked glass panes: the solid front pane is the seal, the faint panes behind are the aura.
check_16px: A solid C; the faint echo panes drop out, which is fine, the C stays clear.

name: Eclipse
rationale: A containment ring that thickens away from the breach it holds.
check_16px: Ring with an off-centre dot survives; it reads as an eye or moon as much as a C.

name: Bulkhead Doors
rationale: Two bulkhead doors slid shut, one bolt across the seam.
check_16px: Disc, seam and bolt all hold in colour; in mono the bolt is the weakest part.

name: Cradle
rationale: A C-shaped aura cupping the breach in a concentric socket; the mouth is narrower than the orb, so it cannot slip out.
check_16px: A C and a dot with clear space between them: the cleanest silhouette of the set.

name: Closing Spiral
rationale: One stroke winding in until it holds a single point.
check_16px: The turns merge into a smudge and the centre dot is lost.

name: Keyhole Halo
rationale: A keyhole standing inside a halo that opens only at its foot.
check_16px: Holds its shape but reads as a generic lock or power icon, not Claura.

name: Enso Pearl
rationale: A calm tapered ring, closed by one pearl set in its mouth.
check_16px: Ring reads; the pearl is only about 1.5 px, and the pair can echo a crescent and star.

name: Closing a
rationale: A C that closes into an a: the stem is the seal.
check_16px: Legible, but as the letters "CI" (continuous integration), the wrong message.
